shots.generation_prompt: Detail shot of a man's left hand gripping a motorcycle handlebar as it rolls over loose rocky ground. Techniscope 35mm (2-perf, 2.39:1), sun-blasted grain pushed harder, heavy grain, framed 2.39:1. Sun-darkened hand steadying the bars. On the left wrist, a vintage watch — dust-caked, crystal scratched, brown leather strap dark with sweat. The watch vibrates with the rough-running engine. Frame full of textures: leather, steel, dust, skin, knuckle. Last golden side-light. The camera holds on the detail for a moment, then pulls back to a wider view.
shots.negative_prompt: No modern watch, no clean hand, no smooth road.

tool_routing.rationale: Watch visibility moment #3 (final). Dialogue line. Needs quality for prop detail and native audio for dialogue under engine.

reference_assets.usage_note: Watch condition — most worn state. Crystal scratched, strap sweaty.

props_in_shot.visibility_note: 1 second. Final watch appearance. Most worn condition. One texture among many — not the subject.

shots.continuity_notes: Watch in most worn state — dustier and more scratched than Scene 1 or 3. Left wrist. Same rough engine vibration. The dialogue line is the only spoken words in the film.
shots.sound_notes: Rough engine thump. Under it, barely audible: 'Primero llegas. Despues compites.' A private decision spoken aloud.

shots.camera_movement: static — same framing as opening shot
shots.framing_notes: Bookend with s01-sh01. Same landscape framing. But now the motorcycle moves RIGHT toward the canyon, not left-to-right across the frame. Hold as bike becomes a speck. Guitar enters. Sun disappears. Blue dusk. Title card.
shots.description: Extreme wide. Same framing as the opening shot. The desert. The mountains. But now the motorcycle moves right toward the canyon shadow. Engine fades. Guitar enters — three notes, nylon strings, a question. The sun disappears. Amber drains. Blue dusk. Title card: THE LAST MARKER. Fade to black.
shots.generation_prompt: Extreme wide shot of Baja California desert — same composition as the film's opening. Techniscope 35mm (2-perf, 2.39:1), sun-blasted grain pushed harder, heavy grain, framed 2.39:1. Flat hardpan, mountain range on horizon, cardon cacti. A motorcycle moves to the right, toward a narrow canyon shadow in the rock face — away from the open desert, away from the course. The dust trail is thin, pink in the last light. The bike grows smaller. The engine sound fades. The sun drops below the western ridge. The amber drains from the landscape. The desert goes cool and blue and still. The motorcycle is a speck. The dust trail is a pink thread. Then blue dusk settles over everything. Title card appears: THE LAST MARKER in vintage pulp typography over the blue dusk landscape.
shots.negative_prompt: No modern elements, no other vehicles, no bright colors after sunset.

tool_routing.rationale: Final shot. Extended duration. Color transition from gold to blue dusk. Must bookend the opening. Needs the best quality and longest generation capability.

reference_assets.usage_note: The end state — this is what the landscape looks like after the sun goes.

shots.continuity_notes: MUST match s01-sh01 landscape composition — same mountain range, same framing. The motorcycle moves RIGHT toward the canyon (not left-to-right as in opening). Color transitions from last gold through rose to blue dusk within this single shot. Title card may need to be composited in post.
shots.sound_notes: Rough engine fading: thump, skip, thump, thump, skip. Growing smaller and fainter. When almost gone, guitar enters — nylon strings, three notes, Mexican folk phrase. A question. Played once. Pause. Once more. Guitar fades. Silence. Total. Four seconds. End.
shots.color_notes: Starts in last gold. Transitions through rose to cool blue dusk. The color arc of the entire film compressed into one shot.

multi_shot_groups.rationale: Three connected shots — boot on kick lever, boot on kick lever again, face between kicks. Consistent framing, lighting, and boot detail across the sequence. Seedance multi-shot generation could produce these as connected clips with locked consistency.
multi_shot_groups.combined_prompt: A sequence of three connected shots in a rocky desert. Techniscope 35mm (2-perf, 2.39:1), sun-blasted grain pushed harder, heavy grain. Last golden side-light. Shot 1: Detail of worn boot on motorcycle kick lever, kick happens, engine turns but doesn't catch. Shot 2: Same framing, second kick, engine almost catches — a cough, a hint. Shot 3: Close on the rider's face between kicks — weathered, 30, Mexican, goggles on forehead. He breathes. Looks west at the last sliver of sun. Resolve and exhaustion.
